# Adient reports fourth quarter and full-year 2026 results, including full-year FCF of $222M


11/4/26


-
-
-
-
-


-
-
-


PLYMOUTH, Mich.


, Nov. 4, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Adient (NYSE: ADNT), a global leader in automotive seating, today announced its fourth quarter 2026 financial results and provided FY 2027 outlook.


- Q4 GAAP net loss and EPS diluted of ($47M) and ($0.62), respectively; Q4 Adj. net income of $40M and Adj.-EPS diluted of $0.52, respectively
- Q4 Adj.-EBITDA of $229M; Adj.-EBITDA margin of 6.1%
- For the full year FY 2026, Adient generated $222M of FCF and returned $100M to shareholders via share repurchases, representing ~6% of shares outstanding at beginning of the fiscal year
- The company repurchased $45M of its shares in the quarter, retiring an additional ~2.3M shares
- The company paid down $35M of notes and refinanced 7% senior secured notes through a $500M add-on to its Term Loan B, further strengthening its balance sheet during the quarter
- Gross debt and net debt totaled ~$2.4B and ~$1.5B, respectively, at September 30, 2026; cash and cash equivalents of $886M at September 30, 2026
- Looking ahead to FY 2027, positive business performance expected to drive modest Adj.-EBITDA improvement and margin expansion despite slightly lower revenue


For complete details and to see reconciliations of non-GAAP measures to their most directly comparable GAAP measures, visit the events section of the Adient investor website at[https://investors.adient.com/events-and-presentations/events](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813208-1&h=1792104240&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.adient.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fevents&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.adient.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fevents) to download the full press release and earnings presentation.


**Investor analyst conference call:** Adient’s president and chief executive officer, Jerome Dorlack, and executive vice president and chief financial officer, Mark Oswald, will host a conference call today at 8:30 a.m. Eastern to discuss the results. To participate by telephone, please dial 888-790-3145 (U.S.) or 630-395-0443 (international) 15 minutes prior to the start time of the call and ask to be connected to the Adient conference call. The conference passcode is ADIENT.


**About Adient:** Adient (NYSE: ADNT) is a global leader in automotive seating. With more than 65,000 employees in 27 countries, Adient operates ~190 manufacturing/assembly plants worldwide. We produce and deliver automotive seating for all major OEMs. From complete seating systems to individual components, our expertise spans every step of the automotive seat-making process. We take our products from research and design to engineering and manufacturing — and into millions of vehicles every year. For more information, please visit[www.adient.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813208-1&h=2387423839&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.adient.com%2F&a=www.adient.com) .
